payload: Add VIRA scraper to Vinahost VPS proxy stack

details.purpose: VIRA = primary VN macro source per Báu methodology (interbank-economist survey on rates, FX, inflation). Geo-blocked outside VN.
details.rationale: User confirmation 2026-05-11: WiData is a paid product and unavailable to this system. VIRA is free + scrapable. Methodology Layer 3 source hierarchy now requires VIRA — without VPS fetch, all VN calls run with VIRA-absence tolerance.
details.depends_on: Vinahost VPS proxy infrastructure (already serves prices, BCTC, news, FX, foreign-flow per reference_vps_setup.md)
details.suggested_owner: ops + dev-team (likely a small Python/TS scraper served via /vira/ endpoint on the VPS gateway)
acceptance: VPS endpoint returns latest VIRA survey snapshot (rates, FX, CPI expectations) as JSON
MCP tool exposed: get_vira_snapshot() or merged into get_macro_snapshot()
TNB cycle log shows VIRA citations once live; gap catalogue entry 'VIRA missing while VPS scraper is live' starts firing
